# `touchcue gpg uninstall`

- **Usage:** `touchcue gpg uninstall [--restore-backup]`

Stop gpg-agent from running touchcue as its scdaemon

## Flags
- **`--restore-backup`** — Replace gpg-agent.conf with the backup taken by install, then delete the backup
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
